subject: English
passage: According to botanist Nnedi Umeh, gardeners in temperate climates ______ four main planting seasons—spring, early summer, late summer, and fall—which they cycle through depending on the crop type.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice C is the best answer. The convention being tested is subject-verb agreement. The plural verb "use" agrees in number with the plural subject "gardeners."
